name: Clicking one cell from each bracket stage reaches four distinct match pages
description: When a visitor clicks one cell from each of Round-of-16, Quarterfinal, Semifinal, and Final in the knockout bracket, they reach four distinct match detail pages — proving the bracket exposes all four stages as real navigation, not decorative cells.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the knockout bracket section
Click one cell in the Round-of-16 area of the bracket
Note the current match detail URL as the first destination
Click one cell in the Quarterfinal area of the bracket
Note the current match detail URL as the second destination
Click one cell in the Semifinal area of the bracket
Note the current match detail URL as the third destination
Click the Final cell in the bracket
Verify the four noted destination URLs are all distinct from each other
